name: Planted Flaretip
description: Holds the curved blade across the chest with the edge outward and the elbow tucked to cover the ribs.

name: Easing Deepbelly
description: Slides the lead foot ahead and drags the rear foot after it without crossing the feet.

name: Short Scoop
description: Swings the broad belly of the blade diagonally down from the shoulder onto the opponent's collar.

name: Lipdash
description: Turns the wrist at the end of a cut and brings the blade back along the same arc from below.

name: Talwarwedge
description: Meets an incoming cut with the flat of the blade and rolls the wrist to slide it aside.

name: Single Arcwheel
description: Cuts straight down from a still stance and stops the edge at the height of the opponent's belt.

name: Narrow Crescent
description: Lifts the hooked belly of the blade from low guard up through the opponent's forearm.

name: Talwarstay
description: Raises the blunt spine to the outside to stop a cut aimed at the head.

name: Light Swellback
description: Pivots on the lead foot a quarter circle and steps the rear foot back out of reach.

name: Short Flowedge
description: Follows a first cut with a second on the way back without pausing to reset the grip.

name: Saddleguard Gauge
description: Watches the opponent's shoulders and lead knee to learn when a cut is coming before it starts.

name: Cantlestay
description: Draws the scimitar from the belt and settles it in a firm guard before the first step.

name: Light Talwar
description: Shuffles forward in short steps keeping the blade raised so the body stays behind it.

name: Narrow Rake
description: Whips the swollen belly of the blade level across the opponent's neck line.

name: Sudden Broadcurve
description: Drops the point and scythes the edge through the opponent's lead knee.

name: Liphusk
description: Lifts the blade flat above the head and catches a falling cut on the curve.

name: Fouling Scimhilt
description: Presses the opponent's weapon down with the back edge and shoves the guard hand clear.

name: Stepping Lop
description: Wheels the whole body around on the rear foot after a missed cut to face the line again.

name: Descending Crescent
description: Cuts the forehand line against a partner's raised blade until the arm tires and the angle stays true.

name: Rakeblow
description: Mirrors the forehand drill on the backhand line with the thumb riding the spine.

name: Lowered Flowedge
description: Twists the forearm in a tight roll to turn aside a cut with the near third of the blade.

name: Carve Dash
description: Lets the weight of the broad belly fall onto a guard and drives it down.

name: Lippace
description: Shifts left and right in two-pace steps while keeping the blade tip pointed at the partner.

name: Talwarbump
description: Answers a parried cut by rapping the edge against the opponent's wrist as it drops.

name: Lipstay
description: Pins the opponent's sword arm with the elbow while the blade is held out of reach.

name: Settled Cantle
description: Runs four guards in order from high to low without dropping the blade from the line.

name: Downward Scimhilt
description: Rolls the wrist over at the start of the cut so the edge arrives with a full arc of speed.

name: Talwardash
description: Links two cuts in a continuous loop so the blade never stops between them.

name: Settled Swellback
description: Flicks the point across the line with the wrist alone to push aside a thrust.

name: Resting Broadcurve
description: Locks the arm and braces the back of the blade with the free palm to stop a heavy cut.

name: Whipcut Pace
description: Spins on the ball of the lead foot to carry the blade around behind a turning opponent.

name: Talwar Hit
description: Draws the blade back across the target with the edge nearest the guard rather than the tip.

name: Talwarcowl
description: Fixes the guard on one slow breath with a thread of qi stiffening the wrist.

name: Upward Cantle
description: Cuts the first diagonal with a pulse of qi that lengthens the stroke a hand-breadth.

name: Saddleguard Blow
description: Crosses the first diagonal with a level cut that finishes at the opponent's far hip.

name: Rakedodge
description: Circles the opponent in small steps with qi lightening the heel at each plant.

name: Holding Flaretip
description: Lays qi along the flat of the blade and turns a cut away with the broad side.

name: Single Carve
description: Pulls the widening edge across the target in a draw that deepens as it passes the belly.

name: Blunt Lop
description: Drops the heavy belly through a downward cut with qi quickening the last third of the fall.

name: Tight Swellback
description: Steers an incoming blade along the swell with a steady thin stream of qi in the wrist.

name: Lipnote
description: Feels along the blade with a pulse of qi to find where the balance sits before a cut.

name: Whipcut Dodge
description: Cuts a wide arc as the body steps back so the edge covers the retreating line.

name: Talwarhusk
description: Presses the back of the blade against the opponent's and shoves it off the line with qi in the arm.

name: Level Arcwheel
description: Flicks the edge across the opponent's gripping hand with a small burst of qi for speed.

name: Straight Rake
description: Cuts downward from the seated position with the shoulder turning the edge over the horse's neck.

name: Downward Scoop
description: Repeats the same overhand cut on foot with the legs driving the weight into it.

name: Folded Crescent
description: Stops a cut with the spine while the off hand stays steady on the rein or the belt.

name: Lopblow
description: Slashes through the target while moving past with the arm held out to the side.

name: Easing Saddleguard
description: Shifts the weight from one hip to the other to turn the mount or the body around a foe.

name: Nabbing Arcwheel
description: Snaps the blade back to guard on its wrist cord after a cut leaves the arm overextended.

name: Square Scimhilt
description: Cuts the forehand arc from shoulder to hip with qi gathering at the wrist on the downstroke.

name: Cantlehit
description: Cuts the mirror arc on the backhand with the elbow leading the edge across the body.

name: Deepbelly Drop
description: Lifts the hooked point under the opponent's guard and tears upward through the forearm.

name: Stepping Whipcut
description: Steps off the line to the outside while the blade covers the body from the chin to the knee.

name: Cantlepause
description: Turns the flat into the path of a cut and carries it wide of the body.

name: Lipwedge
description: Lifts the blunt back of the blade to catch a blow on the strongest part.

name: Rakecowl
description: Hooks the curve over the opponent's wrist and pulls the arm down and across.

name: Low Flaretip
description: Chains forehand and backhand arcs into one unbroken round with qi held steady at the wrist.

name: Flowedge Strike
description: Snaps the point forward a hand-breadth into the gap beside the opponent's guard.

name: Talwar Pause
description: Catches the opponent's sleeve or strap on the hooked point and tugs it off balance.

name: Planted Deepbelly
description: Drops the point and rolls the blade outward to sweep a low cut aside.

name: Talwarhop
description: Closes the distance in one short lunge so the point reaches before the foe can reset.

name: Wide Rake
description: Flicks the point past the opponent's face to force a blink and a flinch.

name: Scoophusk
description: Slips the hook inside the opponent's guard and drags the blade down before cutting.

name: Planted Broadcurve
description: Pulls the point back to the hip and shields the front with the flat of the blade.

name: Descending Cantle
description: Lets the blade's weight carry the cut so the arm only guides it with a thread of qi.

name: Planted Crescent
description: Meets the foe's edge at a slant so that the curve turns the force rather than stopping it.

name: Kind Broadcurve
description: Marks the instant the opponent's weight shifts and prepares the counter during it.

name: Stepping Scoop
description: Leads every step with the hip so the blade stays square to the foe through the turn.

name: Lop Drop
description: Loosens the grip until the blade swings free then tightens at the moment of contact.

name: Settled Flowedge
description: Gives a half step back while catching a blow on the spine so the force dies in the retreat.
